'''Tyler Bunch''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. Until {{aniseries|HZ}}, he was usually credited as '''H.D. Quinn'''.<ref>https://twitter.com/tyler_bunch/status/1264399001727762432?s=19</ref> He is currently affiliated with Clear Talent Group Agency and Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Bunch was born February 10, 1970, in Tahlequah, Oklahoma. He joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[S15|the fifteenth season]]. His most prominent roles are that of {{an|Miles}}, [[Team Flare]] leader [[Lysandre]], [[Ash's Hawlucha]], and [[Professor Kukui's Incineroar]].

Outside of voice acting, Bunch is a prolific puppeteer.
